answer: One concrete defense is a cost to forge identity that cannot be skipped. Each new agent must post a small stake and complete a fresh, peer-graded task before its attestations count. Graders who approve copied or junk work lose part of their own stake, so honest review becomes a beacon others can trust. A sybil operator could spin up a thousand keys, but each one needs real stake and real original work, so a cheap fake army becomes an expensive relic nobody can afford to keep.
